_comment: Placeholder content overlay. The real copy lives in content.local.json (git-ignored). Each act pairs the canonical spoken phrase the recognizer listens for with the Title Case video.action it records; aliases are extra phrases that record the same action, for words the small speech model hears differently. library_root, chrome_profile and scrape_provider are the machine-specific values the app needs at runtime. project_roots is optional: the folders holding the suite's sibling app checkouts (fun_time, origenerator, clipper, scripture), searched in order, for when those repos do not live under library_root/projects; omit it and that is exactly where they are looked for. retired_root is optional too: where a non-AI original goes once its upscale is made, with its sidecar and funscript beside it. Omit it and the original stays in the library, in its bucket's '2*' folder, which is what the user does by hand; set it to somewhere off the working drive when those folders would otherwise fill it. genau_source names the 0_inbox folder Origenerator drops a looping Genau clip in; it lives here rather than in source because naming a folder inside the library makes that name library vocabulary, which the sanitize harvester then blocks. Origenerator reads the same key from its own overlay and the two must agree. curated_examples is optional: tile label -> the id of the clip that best illustrates it, for the acts the library has no clip tagged with. It names clips inside the library, so it lives here rather than in source; leave it empty and every tile takes the first library clip whose action matches. excerpt_folders is optional: library-relative folders holding scenes carved out of longer videos and nothing else, for the batches that were split before anything recorded a clip block; it is here rather than in source because a folder name is library vocabulary.
